description: Source file implementing the MPSStream class for Metal Performance Shaders integration in PyTorch, managing GPU command buffers, synchronization, and error handling.

classes.name: MPSStream
classes.description: Manages Metal command queues, command buffers, synchronization, and error handling for GPU operations.

methods.name: commandBuffer
methods.description: Returns the current command buffer, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Returns the Metal device associated with the command queue.

methods.name: commandEncoder
methods.description: Returns the current compute command encoder, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Performs synchronization based on the specified SyncType.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the current command buffer, or flushes if commitAndContinue is disabled.

methods.name: commitAndWait
methods.description: Commits the current command buffer and waits for completion.

methods.name: commitAndContinue
methods.description: Commits the command buffer and continues without waiting.

methods.name: endKernelCoalescing
methods.description: Ends encoding of current kernel commands.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the command buffer, optionally keeping it for later waiting.

methods.name: addCompletedHandler
methods.description: Adds a completion handler to the command buffer.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills a buffer with a specified value, batching for large sizes.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies data between buffers, batching for large sizes.

methods.name: copy_and_sync
methods.description: Copies buffers and performs synchronization based on non-blocking flag.

methods.name: executeMPSGraph
methods.description: Encodes and executes an MPS graph, with optional profiling and synchronization.

methods.name: getErrorBuffer
methods.description: Returns the buffer containing error messages.

methods.name: checkLastError
methods.description: Checks for errors in the error buffer and throws if any.
